types.name: Basic average and sums
types.description: Find an average, a sum or a missing number from given averages, including averages of squares, cubes, multiples, or after every number is changed by the same amount.

types.name: Consecutive numbers and first n numbers
types.description: Average of consecutive numbers, consecutive odd or even numbers, or the first n natural, even or odd numbers; or a term found from such an average.

types.name: Average of combined groups
types.description: Two or more groups (boys and girls, sections, workers) with their own averages are combined, or the size of a group is found from the overall average.

types.name: A member joins or leaves
types.description: One or more people or numbers are added to or removed from a group, changing the average; find the new average or the person who joined or left.

types.name: One member replaced by another
types.description: A person in a group is replaced by a new person (group size stays the same) and the average rises or falls; find the new person’s value.

types.name: Wrong entry corrected
types.description: Some numbers were copied or read wrongly while finding an average; find the correct average or the correct number.

types.name: Overlapping parts of a list
types.description: Averages of the whole list and of its first few and last few (or middle) numbers are given; find a common or particular number.

types.name: Batting average and run rate
types.description: Cricket context: batting or bowling average after an innings, runs needed to change an average, or required run rate in remaining overs.

types.name: Average age
types.description: Average ages of people or a family now, years ago, or after a birth or marriage; find one person’s age.
